dossiers_written.name: Lan Na (continuation of lan-na-kingdom, same state)

gaps.what: The Cliopatria row is the Mekong delta that the Khmer Empire row loses in 1700, not a Cambodian state; all three shapes marked wrong with empty corrections and the land drawn by nguyen-lords from 1700. Needs the orchestrator's decision (keep as null row, merge into post-angkor-cambodia, or keep the delta Cambodian to 1757).

No page opened dates the Gia Dinh (1698), Ha Tien (1708) or Tam Phong Long (1757) annexations; the delta is handed over in 1700 at confidence 2 and the western strip in 1755; champa's 1611 Phu Yen loss is unmirrored (the Panduranga page implies Nguyen held it earlier).
Thuan Hoa held by the Trinh 1775-1786 is confidence 2 (no page says so in words); no months for 1786; undated Gianh frontier; the Tay Son occupation of Thang Long in 1786 not drawn.

No page gives Lan Na's extent 1558-1775, so no territorial gain or loss is dated; vassal records for 1757/1763 (konbaung-dynasty) and 1775 (thonburi-kingdom) are not yet written; merge with lan-na-kingdom is the orchestrator's call.

The 1828 loss of land around Champasak town is Cliopatria's (page silent, confidence 1); 1709-1712 land has no state; the kingdom's right-bank rump 1893-1904 and house to 1946 are not drawn; Cliopatria has no French Indochina over the Left Bank in 1894.

problems: lan-na is the same state as lan-na-kingdom (shared Q1059707); lan-na-kingdom.json belongs to another batch and was not edited, so lan-na.json continues it from 1565; merge is the orchestrator's decision.

cambodia (Cliopatria 'Cambodia' 1700-1802) is a null row (the Mekong delta that the Khmer Empire row loses in 1700); kingdom-of-cambodia (1956-2024, also Q424) is a different, modern state and was not merged.

Page budgets: nguyen-lords opened 6 pages against 5 (Nam tien was thin); trinh-lords 7 of 9; lan-na 3 of 5; cambodia 2 of 2; kingdom-of-champasak 5 of 5 (the first, 'Champasak', is a disambiguation page).
WebFetch returns summaries, not page text: quotes in the dossiers are those the tool marked as quotations; other statements are paraphrases and are marked so in the notes where noticed.
The Wikipedia field of the kingdom-of-champasak seed ('Champasak') is a disambiguation page; the dossier's wikipedia field uses 'Kingdom of Champasak'.
